criteria.description: Breaks 'quality' into multiple distinct, observable criteria (e.g. captures decisions, action items with owners, next steps, accuracy) rather than one overall score.
Each criterion has concrete anchors describing what a PASS vs a FAIL looks like in observable terms, not adjectives like 'clear' or 'good'.
Uses a reliable discrete scale (pass/fail or anchored 3-point) rather than an unanchored 1-10 scale.
Includes calibration/example outputs (e.g. a clear pass, a clear fail, a borderline case) to anchor the judge.
Identifies gating criteria (a severe failure fails the item) and/or defines how criteria aggregate into a verdict.
Specifies validating the judge against human labels (an agreement target) and a re-check cadence.
